company.name: GIMO
company.shortDescription: GIMO is a fintech company that caters to the need of on-demand pay service of the businesses and workers.
company.description: Founded in 2019, Vietnam's fintech company Gimo provides Earned Wage Access (EWA) and other payroll services to underbanked Vietnamese workers. The company aspires to tap into millions of workers who don’t have a bank account or have limited access to financial services, helping them to alleviate their financial stress and build financial security, thus driving financial inclusion in Vietnam and the region.

productsAndServices.description: Allows employees to access their earned wages anytime before the official payday without interest or hidden fees.
productsAndServices.name: Flexible Payroll Solution (Nhận lương linh hoạt)

productsAndServices.description: A platform offering diverse employee welfare products including financial health tools, essential shopping benefits, and health care services.

productsAndServices.description: Tools for employees to record daily expenses and earn rewards redeemable for gifts and discounts.
productsAndServices.name: Expense Tracking and Reward System

productsAndServices.description: Enables employees to recharge their mobile phone accounts conveniently through the Gimo platform using their earned wages.
productsAndServices.name: Phone Top-up Service (Nạp điện thoại)

productsAndServices.description: Collaborations with financial companies to expand access to flexible financial welfare solutions for workers nationwide.
productsAndServices.name: Partnership Ecosystem with Financial Institutions

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,883,034 to $64,238,723, a 10.92x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
